thread:
liam: Quick sync: choosing internal API shape for routing policies. Proto/gRPC vs JSON/REST? Main constraints: quotas, telemetry, console UX, browser compatibility.
jen: Proto gives typed contracts and clean quota keys. JSON is easier for docs and SDKs.
arik: Option: JSON at edge -> proto internal via translator. Ops cost + streaming bridge are concerns.
sasha: Browser teams hit gRPC-web friction previously; we should minimize that.
liam: Telemetry: proto lets us add explicit route tags. With JSON we either parse or rely on edge headers.
jen: Edge can validate and emit signed X-Route-Claim header for backends. That reduces backend parsing.
arik: Agree. Need key rotation plan for signature and Console visibility.
liam: Proposal: 2-month dual-mode POC: edge JSON + internal proto translator. Canary small tenants.
deploy-bot: canary deploy for edge-translator v0.1 -> cluster-a (1% traffic).
liam: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
arik: :thumbsup:
